notes: 2026-01-15 - Intro demo (Maya + Rohit). Product team: Head of Search (Ari Dobson), Eng manager (Priya K.). Liked the hosted demo; wants hard numbers on queries/sec and p95 latency.
Ari: 'Need semantic search to feel instant for support agents — p50 < 80ms, p95 < 350ms for typical queries across our 4M doc index.'
Current infra: Postgres primary with pgvector for longtail projects; experimenting with Pinecone for regional booths. Wants turnkey connector to their PG + S3 cold store.
Data footprint: ~4.2M content items (articles, tickets, transcripts), average vector dim 1536. Nightly batch ingestion ~120k docs; realtime delta ~200 docs/sec during peak.
Cost sensitivity: mid-level. 'We can trade cost for latency but need predictable unit economics' — finance will require example cost per 1M queries/1M embeddings.
Security: must support SSO (SAML + Okta), audit logs forwarded to Splunk, optional KMS for keys. Data residency EU for subset of customers (multi-region routing asked).
Integration ask: demo of bulk embed pipeline (CSV/S3 -> Redwood hosted embeddings) and an example connector that writes vectors to pgvector. Rohit asked for sample code and a job template.
AE notes: started hosted API trial (free credits). Team ran ~10k queries/day; saw good quality but want Dedicated for predictable throughput and cheaper token pricing for batch embedding runs.
Procurement: procurement loop expects SOC2 + pricing escalation path. Legal requested MSA changes (data residency clause) 2026-02-08.
Customer tone: exploratory but pragmatic. Prioritized reliability > bleeding-edge model accuracy. Interested in Redwood's routing/fallback for region outages.

requirements_summary: Workload type: embeddings-heavy + semantic search for support knowledge base
Throughput targets: query QPS target 400 sustained, peaks 1k; p50 < 80ms, p95 < 350-400ms for search queries
Batch jobs: nightly 120k new docs -> embeddings; target embed throughput 2k-5k/sec in dedicated POC
Vector DB integration: must support pgvector write path and optional export to Pinecone; preference to keep canonical vectors in customer's Postgres
Model preferences: open/LLMs for embeddings (1536 dim), willing to test Redwood-verified open models; interest in quantized model variants for cost
Routing/fallback: multi-region routing + fallback to lower-cost model variant during capacity events
Security/compliance: SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs to SIEM, optional KMS/HSM, EU data residency for subset
poc_details: Plan: 30-day POC. Phase 1 (hosted): validate quality + integration with pgvector using sample 100k dataset. Phase 2 (dedicated): deploy 2 Dedicated nodes for throughput tests and nightly batch runs.
Success criteria: embed ingestion pipeline runs nightly under 6 hours; query p95 on 4M corpus < 400ms; consistent cost estimates for 1M embeddings/month
Metrics we'll capture: tokens/embedding cost, median & 95th latency, successful batch throughput, memory/KV cache hit rates
SE tasks: provide sample S3 -> Redwood embed job template, Postgres connector example, Dedicated benchmark runbook
Timeline: kickoff 2026-03-01 (subject to MSA), host run of 7-day smoke, then 21-day stress + regression tests
pricing_concerns: Need side-by-side TCO: hosted per-token vs Dedicated fixed + variable for embeddings heavy workloads
Finance wants explicit cost per 1M embeddings and 1M search queries at 95th percentile — include caching assumptions
Prefers a committed reserved baseline for Dedicated with burst capacity; asked about overage pricing and SLAs
